english.title: Sell alcohol to a person aged under 18
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) sold alcohol to a person under the age of 18, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AGE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 146(1) and (7) of the Licensing Act 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
sold alcohol to a person under the age of eighteen years
english.notes:
As from 08/04/2013 Penalty Notices for Disorder may ONLY be issued to offenders aged 18 years or over.

This offence may be disposed of by the issue of a Penalty Notice for Disorder - DA18

(i) The Penalty Notice for Disorder was raised from £80 to £90 as from 01/07/13
(ii) Paragraph 24H of the National Police Records (Recordable Offences) (Amendment) Regulations 2005 specifically deems this offence to be a recordable offence for the purposes of PNC. Therefore offenders must be fingerprinted and photographed as well as PNC recordable.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Penalty Notice for Disorder - Ninety pounds.

Note:
As from 08/04/2013 Penalty Notices for Disorder may ONLY be issued to offenders aged 18 years or over.

Time limit for prosecutions:
12 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
